candidates.title: Crown Him with Many Crowns

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lines: Hark! how the heav'nly anthem drowns
Of Him who died for thee
And hail Him as thy matchless King

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lines: Crown Him the Lord of love
But downward bends his wand'ring eye

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lines: Crown Him the Lord of life
And rose victorious in the strife
For those He came to save
Who died, and rose on high
Who died, eternal life to bring
And lives that death may die

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lines: For Thou hast died for me
Thy praise shall never, never fail
